rationale.A: ~4 km in mixed traffic on Korutie, Kanneltie, Kantelettarentie, Ilkantie and Nuijamiestentie, with 9 unsignalised arterial crossings
rationale.B: Rail-side path and Central Park, but 510 m in traffic on Naapuripellontie (30 km/h); 5 lights
rationale.C: Residential paths through Malminkartano, then the rail-side path, Central Park and Töölönlahti; least roadside riding; 3 lights; +2 min
rationale.D: No mixed traffic, but ~2.9 km on tracks beside Nuijamiestentie, Kantelettarentie and Näyttelijäntie
rationale.E: Kartanonkaari-side track and Kaupinmäki paths, then the rail-side path and Central Park; 2 lights; +2 min
rationale.F: Same as E with a short jog via Ohjaajantie/Aino Acktén tie
rationale.G: Kaarela and Keskuspuistontaival through Central Park; little roadside riding; 2 lights; +3 min
rationale.H: Malminkartano station paths beside Korutie, then the rail-side path and Central Park; 3 lights

notes: Almost any alternative beats A, which rides about 4 km in mixed traffic. C (+2) is the calmest. E (+2) has the fewest lights (2 vs 5); G has as few lights but is +3.
